'''Chak-root''' was a flavorful [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew in the marshlands of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Erysthes]]. The plant could also be found on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

The sale of this plant carried high taxes, so it was a favorite of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="GSWU" /> Chak-root could be made into a [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] and a [[snuff]].
